findings: Rule classifier organizes files, not duplicate detection. Smart mode prioritizes substring filename keywords before extension and UTType; phrase matches score 3 versus other keywords 2, confidence capped at 96. No word-boundary or empty-keyword rejection appears here.
Extension conflicts choose first enabled category. Semantic ties sort by score only without an explicit secondary criterion. Profile order therefore affects classification and user moves.

Format-only fallback labels unknown files Other at confidence 100: this is policy certainty, not decoded format verification. UTType image/movie/audio fallback likewise does not validate full media contents.
Seven original tests pass including 13 authored format examples. Total distinct original tests passed across focused runs is 45; this is not universal format support or duplicate-quality proof.
